shared_prompt: Use case: productivity-visual. Create ONE premium 16:9 widescreen PowerPoint background plate for 棚智未来, an agricultural AI platform. Input image is a STYLE REFERENCE only: preserve its refined photographic botanical macro aesthetics, velvety dark forest-green, jade translucent tomato leaf veins, subtle warm golden rim-light, atmospheric depth and premium editorial finish. Create a DIFFERENT composition belonging to the SAME slide family. Background ONLY, no text, lettering, logos, watermark, numbers, frames, UI, charts, robots or collage. Keep plentiful smooth unobstructed negative space for slide content, avoid high contrast details behind content. Agricultural elegance, restrained and natural, no sci-fi neon or generic technology circuitry. Landscape aspect ratio 16:9.
